evidence.reason: The regex at lines 99-102 is the dependency-directive scan, and its own comments (lines 104-108) state the scan reads every loadable unit type because a co-installed unit with a dependency directive can act on the selected unit. The directive alternation already includes start/stop-relevant and obscure directives (Wants, BindsTo, Conflicts, Upholds, OnFailure, Triggers, TriggersBy), so it is intended to be a comprehensive dependency scan. It omits systemd v257's `PropagatesStopTo=` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom=`, which are precisely stop-propagation dependencies: a co-installed `backup.service` with `PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service` stops the selected unit when the backup is stopped, yet the scan would not see it and could report `supported=True`. This is a false-negative in existing intended behavior, not a request to enlarge protection scope; the smallest compatible fix is adding the two directive names to the alternation.
